blocks.text: Here in the Seoul Box, we are standing in a symbolic space of the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea. This space currently hosts the second exhibition of the MMCA×LG OLED Series, which launched for the first time last year. This collaborative project was developed by the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea in partnership with LG Electronics. By combining advanced display technology and artistic imagination, this series offers visitors new ways of experiencing contemporary art.

For this year's edition, artist Christine Sun Kim has transformed this space by utilizing the architectural characteristics of the Seoul Box to create a monumental installation consisting of large-scale digital animation and wall drawings. Artist Christine Sun Kim, a Berlin-based Korean American, has explored language, sound, and structures of communication across a diverse range of media, including drawing, moving image, and performance. She has gained significant recognition in the contemporary art world, including being ranked 34th on a 2025 British contemporary art magazine list of the most influential figures in international contemporary art.

Kim has developed a distinctive artistic language that translates communicative language into visual form. Rooted in the experiences of deaf communities, her work draws upon a wide range of visual elements, including American Sign Language, musical notation, the motion lines of comic books, handwritten drawings, diagrams, and text. Through these elements, Kim visually reveals how language forms and transforms interpersonal relationships, and how it connects us to the world at large.

Her work invites us to reconsider the systems and conventions of communication that we often take for granted. In recent years, her practice has expanded beyond individual drawings and performances into immersive spatial environments, transforming language itself into a three-dimensional experience. Within this space, we are invited to experience the ways in which language is generated, moves, and collides through multiple senses.
